description: A new BKT session has begun. Emitted when a learner starts a reading session and the first encounter event is recorded. Used for session-duration analytics, streak tracking, and session-level provenance.

learnerDid.description: The learner who started this session.

sessionId.description: Unique session identifier. Format: session-{date}-{seq}. Groups all encounter records and private interpretation updates for this session.

startedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the session started.

sourceType.description: Type of activity that started this session.

register.description: Register of content for this session.

deviceType.description: Device type if reported by client (mobile, desktop, web).

appVersion.description: Client app version for regression detection.
